 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 14-06-2023 Heard Mr. Mayank Bilochan, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No.180C/2021,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

It is alleged that the marriage of the complainant was solemnized with the petitioner in the year of 2010 and soon after the marriage, she was subjected to harassment and torture on account of non-fulfillment of demand of dowry resulting in lodging of the present case.
Submission has been made on behalf of the petitioner that the complainant voluntarily deserted the petitioner though the petitioner is still ready to keep the complainant as his wife Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.19829 of 2023(2) dt.14-06-2023 with dignity and honor.

Considering the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner, let notice be issued to the opposite party No. 2 both by ordinary process as well as registered post with A/D for which requisites etc.
must be filed within a period of two weeks from today, failing which this application shall stand dismissed, without further reference to a Bench.
List this case after service of notice or appearance of the opposite party No. 2 whichever is earlier on 27.07.2023.
